map.租赁合同按要素组装：出租与承租方信息 + 租赁物描述（地址、面积、附属设施）+: The lease contract is assembled by elements: lessor and lessee information + leased property description (address, area, ancillary facilities) + lease term and start/end dates + rent and payment method (monthly, one-month deposit with three months prepaid) + deposit (usually 1 to 3 months rent) + maintenance responsibility division + breach and termination clauses + sublease terms + dispute resolution + signature block; clauses are numbered "Article X", and blanks are marked with placeholders for filling.

map.起草租赁合同前列一份条款清单：租金与支付方式、押金、维修责任、转租与退租条件等。: Before drafting a lease, list a clause checklist: rent and payment method, deposit, maintenance responsibility, sublease and move-out conditions, etc.
map.与租客协商前先看看标准条款通常覆盖哪些内容，避免遗漏关键约定。: Before negotiating with the tenant, review what standard clauses usually cover, to avoid missing key agreements.
map.多套房源批量出合同时，先用模板对齐口径再逐份填空，减少前后不一致。: When generating contracts in bulk for multiple properties, first align the wording with a template then fill each one, reducing inconsistency.
map.生成结果长什么样: What does the generated result look like
map.设定生成数量后，工具按租赁物类型与期限组合出若干条条款要点（如\"月租金 ___: After setting the generation count, the tool produces several clause points by property type and term combination (e.g. "monthly rent ____ CNY, payable before the ____ day each month", "deposit ____ months rent, refunded within ____ days after move-out inspection", "the property main structure and natural wear are maintained by Party A, damage caused by Party B improper use is borne by Party B"); the underlined parts are placeholders to fill. Fill the placeholders with actual numbers and dates to use as a draft.
map.生成的文本能直接当合同用吗？: Can the generated text be used directly as a contract?
map.不能。它是条款要点与填空模板，用于起草和查漏，不构成法律意见。正式合同建议结合当: No. It is clause points and a fill-in template, for drafting and gap-checking, not legal advice. For a formal contract, use the model text of the local housing department; for significant value, consult a lawyer.
map.为什么每次生成的内容不完全一样？: Why is the generated content not exactly the same each time?
map.工具从常见条款组合中随机取样，同一参数多次生成会得到不同条目。建议多生成几次，把: The tool randomly samples from common clause combinations; the same parameters generate different entries each time. It is recommended to generate several times and pick the needed clauses to assemble a complete list.

map.按租赁物与期限生成租赁合同模板，预置租金、押金与责任条款填空位，供起草参考，纯前: Generates a lease contract template based on the leased property and term, with pre-set blanks for rent, deposit, and liability clauses; for drafting reference only and not legal advice. Runs fully in the browser.
map.合同底稿按固定顺序组装：双方信息 → 租赁物（地址/面积/附属设施）→ 租赁期限: The draft is assembled in a fixed order: parties → leased property (address/area/facilities) → term → rent and payment → deposit and refund → repairs → optional clauses (cost allocation/subletting/handover/early termination) → disputes → signing and annexes. Core clauses always appear; missing fields are marked “To be completed: field” for item-by-item completion. The template does not guarantee suitability for every region or special property; check local law, model contracts and professional advice before signing.

map.起草前先填双方、房屋地址、面积、租期、租金、押金与支付方式，核心条款会固定输出，: Before drafting, fill the parties, address, area, term, rent, deposit and payment method; core clauses always appear, so rent or term are never randomly omitted.
map.按实际交易勾选费用承担、转租限制、房屋交接、提前解约等可选条款，不需要的条款不出: Tick the optional clauses that fit the deal: cost allocation, subletting, handover and early termination; unneeded clauses do not appear.

map.缺失甲方与租金的底稿: Draft with party A and rent missing

Rent or term clauses are never randomly dropped.
map.还会随机漏条款吗？: Can clauses still be randomly omitted?
map.不会。核心条款按固定顺序始终输出；只有费用承担、转租限制、房屋交接、提前解约四项: No. Core clauses always appear in a fixed order; only the four optional clauses (cost allocation, subletting, handover, early termination) depend on ticks. Missing fields are highlighted yellow; no random subset of ten clauses is drawn.
map.生成的文本能直接签吗？: Can the generated text be signed directly?

Before signing, compare with the local housing authority model contract and have a local professional review it.
